name: Intersystem Transport Ship
description: The Intersystem Transport Ship, also known as the I-TS, was a class of transport ship used by the Resistance. The ship was built by Corellian Engineering Corporation and primarily used as a long-haul cargo and troop transport. It was equipped with forward and rear guns to defend against pirates. The vehicle was also equipped with a hyperdrive. The versatility of the vessel made it indispensable for the Resistance and critical for transporting troops between bases.
